item.title: REF 0.12.0
item.description:
• REF plug-in: fold the reference away to one line when you just want the meters. Click it, or drop a song on it, to bring it back. Each project remembers its fold.
  • REF plug-in: a new Master strip shows your master's waveform as the DAW plays it, with the DAW's bars, marks where peaks hit 0 dB, and the loudest true peak in view. Playing a section again shows the last pass ahead of the playhead, dimmed.
  • REF plug-in: its window uses much less CPU. Waveforms are drawn once, the zoomed waveforms scroll as pictures, and nothing redraws while nothing plays.
  • REF plug-in: your library is safer. Saves happen one at a time, and a damaged library file is set aside instead of written over.
  • REF plug-in: measures several songs at a time, like the app.
